english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an individual or immediate situation of overwhelming panic.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a sudden loss of composure or courage in a frightening situation.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person’s dismay or alarm, especially when they are visibly flustered.

examples.english: I was in a panic when I heard that loud bang.
examples.traditional: 我聽到嗰聲巨響，成個人都驚慌晒。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou2 go2 seng1 geoi6 hoeng2 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 ging1 fong1 saai3

examples.english: The fire was so big that I was overcome with dismay and didn’t know what to do.
examples.traditional: 見到火勢咁大，我即刻驚慌，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping: gin3 dou2 fo2 sai3 gam3 daai6 ngo5 zik1 hak1 ging1 fong1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2

examples.english: When the whole street suddenly lost power, everyone was thrown into consternation.
examples.traditional: 見到成條街突然停電，大家即刻驚慌失措。
examples.jyutping: gin3 dou2 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dat6 jin4 ting4 din6 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 ging1 fong1 sat1 cou3
